script.spokenHook: The entire market is sliding today, yet Hyperliquid is trading near its daily high.
segmentLines: HYPE gained over 19% to reach $95.48 while the total market cap fell about 2%.
It is currently sitting at 93% of its 24-hour range with an overbought RSI of almost 89.
This move comes as Decrypt reports the NYSE owner is moving to bring its perpetual futures to the US.
script.takeaway: Trading near daily highs despite overbought RSI
script.cta: Is this a sustainable breakout or is the RSI too high? Tell me below and follow for the next move.
script.title: HYPE surges 19% to $95.48 while the total market drops 2% 📈 #Shorts
